request: On constructed reconciliation cases, how do packages built with the pinned Codex-oriented Dovetail pack compare with packages built from the common request, and do either improve completion over a consumer with complete task facts and no generated package?
intended_use: Discover contract-feature failures, score saturation, independent-build variation and observed resource use before deciding whether this task family merits a broader builder comparison.
facts: The user selected synthetic reconciliation cases for this implementation milestone.
This trial measures explicit use of generated skills in the pinned native runtime.
assumptions: This is condition discovery on one synthetic task contract, with no population or general builder-ranking claim.
The supplied materials are Yassa-owned synthetic files with declared agent authorship; the route does not establish human authorship.
Supplied and prepared cases share development examples and the empty evaluation problem; they are related conditions, not independent workload samples.
Two builds per arm and condition investigate build variation; one use per package and case prioritizes coverage over estimating execution variability.
The 600-second build deadline gives each treatment more opportunity than the earlier 300-second fixture; no package selection or harness retries are permitted.
The 60-second consumer deadline bounds each small file task; native command reservations exclude setup/export, and hard token/spend caps are unavailable.
unresolved: Pin the exact external Dovetail runtime snapshot and bind it to the dovetail arm before exporting a runnable study.

arms.invocation: Use $better-skill-creator to create the requested skill.

control_rationale.common-request: Contribution of the external builder pack compared with the same build request and pinned built-in skills; this is not an explicitly invoked official-creator comparison.
control_rationale.dovetail: Contribution of the exact external Dovetail runtime pack and explicit creator invocation under the common build and use conditions.
control_rationale.no-package: Contribution of generated-package assistance during execution when complete task facts, current input files, model and consumer deadline are shared.
